metadata.question: Did the inundation region within a 10 km radius around Ingeniero White port, Argentina, increase on March 11, 2025 compared to January 30, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Ingeniero White port, Argentina (approximately -38.78°S, -62.27°W) - Need to create a 10 km radius buffer around the port - Dates: January 30, 2025 and March 11, 2025 - Collection: Sentinel-1 SAR (C-band) is ideal for flood/inundation detection as it works in all weather conditions - Fallback: If Sentinel-1 fails, try Sentinel-2 with water indices (though clouds may be an issue) 2. Masking strategy: - For SAR (Sentinel-1): Use VV or VH polarization, threshold to detect water (typically VV < -15 dB indicates water) - Lower backscatter values indicate water/inundation - No cloud masking needed for SAR 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If inundation area is 0 or very small, but calculation succeeded → Answer based on comparison - C1: If no Sentinel-1 images for either date - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels after processing (unlikely with SAR) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - A: If March 11 inundation > January 30 inundation - B: If March 11 inundation <= January 30 inundation ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const port = ee.Geometry.Point([-62.27, -38.78]); const aoi = port.buffer(10000); // 10 km radius const date1 = '2025-01-30'; const date2 = '2025-03-11'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Sentinel-1 SAR data for flood detection const s1_jan = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2025-01-28', '2025-02-01') .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const s1_mar = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2025-03-09', '2025-03-13') .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const count_jan = s1_jan.size().getInfo(); const count_mar = s1_mar.size().getInfo(); console.log(`January images: ${count_jan}, March images: ${count_mar}`); if (count_jan === 0 || count_mar === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-1 data available for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Water detection using SAR backscatter threshold const img_jan = s1_jan.median(); const img_mar = s1_mar.median(); // Water detection: VV < -15 dB typically indicates water const water_jan = img_jan.lt(-15); const water_mar = img_mar.lt(-15); // 4. Calculate inundation area const scale = 10; // Sentinel-1 resolution const stats_jan = water_jan.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats_mar = water_mar.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count_pixels_jan = water_jan.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const water_pixels_jan = stats_jan.get('VV').getInfo(); const water_pixels_mar = stats_mar.get('VV').getInfo(); const total_pixels_jan = count_pixels_jan.get('VV').getInfo(); console.log(`Total pixels analyzed: ${total_pixels_jan}`); if (total_pixels_jan === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (water_pixels_jan === null || water_pixels_mar === null || isNaN(water_pixels_jan) || isNaN(water_pixels_mar)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert to area (pixels * scale^2) const area_jan_km2 = (water_pixels_jan * scale * scale) / 1e6; const area_mar_km2 = (water_pixels_mar * scale * scale) / 1e6; console.log(`January 30, 2025 inundation: ${area_jan_km2.toFixed(3)} km2 (${water_pixels_jan} pixels)`); console.log(`March 11, 2025 inundation: ${area_mar_km2.toFixed(3)} km2 (${water_pixels_mar} pixels)`); console.log(`Change: ${(area_mar_km2 - area_jan_km2).toFixed(3)} km2`); if (area_mar_km2 > area_jan_km2) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
